title: Shared delivery state across Telegram and the phone app
goal: One record per message says where it was sent, delivered and opened, so both channels read the same state
acceptance: A delivery has a per-channel state (sent, failed, opened) in one store, additive migration
A test across Telegram and push delivery shows both states on one delivery
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
validation: Targeted store, push and telegram tests
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one additive table and the writes from both channels. Not a measurement. 2026-11-25: implemented in PR #758 (delivery_channels, Telegram and push writes, coordinator RPC); remaining: CI and merge.
